main_text.l: um, & intoentium animos ad libidinem so-
licitat citius, quàm ad honestam opinionem.
Decet autem vt virgo tota & vndique virgo
sit, nec vlla ex parte det corruptæ mentis fi-
gnificationem.
Quarto loquitur de impatietia correptio-
nis spiritus in carnalibus hominibus prisci
seculi. Ait enim, Non contendet spiritus me-
us cum homine in perpetuum: vel, vt Luthe-
rus vertit: Die menschen wöllen sich meinen geist nicht mehr
straffen lassen: eò quòd ipsi caro sunt, id est, quia carnalibus operibus se-
ipsos totos dedunt, & animæ substantia abu-
tuntur, & quasi sola carne circundati anima
carerent, sic vitam suam abfumunt: quemad-
modum Chrysost. ait.
Alij autem hæc Dei verba sic exponunt:
Spiritus meus. i. verbi mei arguens per mi-
nistros prophetas mundum de peccato, non
amplius homines iudicabit aut corripiet.
Est vero hæc grauissima pœna, subtractio vi
del. verbi Dei, Amos. 8. Sunt prætere a qui
interpretantur spiritum Dei, de vitali spiri-
tu, quem homini Deus sit adempturus, ad-
ducto in terram diluvio: qui spiritus, Dei
spiritus appelletur, vt a Deo Adamo in-
spiratus.
Postremò fit hoc loco mentio annorum
120. ad pœnitentiam assignatorum, quibus
resipiscerent: qui locus de lenitate Dei est, pœ-
ni ad ignoscendum, de qua Luc.12. Rom. 2.1.
Pet.3.& 2.Pet. 3. Diluvium enim subito non
invehit,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "intoentium" as printed; "fi-gnificationem" hyphen partly visible; "videl." at the line end "vi" has no clear hyphen, so it may be "vi-del." or a damaged word; "assignatorum" is printed "a fignatorum" with a space, probably a printer's split; "resipiscerent" is printed with blurred letters; "pœ-ni" reads as a broken word, possibly "pœnitentiam" in part; the Fraktur "meinen geist" in the German line is partly blurred, the second word may read "gĕist". Printed "120." is read as arabic numerals. Long s is normalised to s throughout, including "Chrysost." and "sit".
